literal.prompt: Какой орган помогает человеку чувствовать прикосновение к поверхности тела?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The question concerns tactile perception at the body surface. OpenStax describes skin as an organ and its sensory fibers (skin source L32-36), then identifies Merkel cells and Meissner corpuscles as touch receptors (L59, L89). The liver, small intestine and lung sources identify these options as distinct organ systems/functions (liver L35, L39; intestine L32-34; lungs L31-33). The targeted 11,000-row MAIN search found no same relation; the closest prior skin item asks about outer covering/largest area and is recorded as a distinct fact in the bilateral peer review.
literalGroups.locator: OpenStax skin L32-36, L59, L89; liver L35, L39; intestine L32-34; lungs L31-33

literalGroups.literal: Кожа содержит рецепторы прикосновения и сенсорные нервные волокна, передающие сигналы в мозг. Клетки Меркеля и тельца Мейснера — типы кожных тактильных рецепторов.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Skin is an organ with sensory nerve fibers, and OpenStax locates touch receptors including Merkel cells and Meissner corpuscles in the skin. These passages support the explanation; the failed NCBI response was not used as proof.
literalGroups.locator: OpenStax skin L32-36 (organ/protection/structure), L33 (sensory fibers), L59 (Merkel receptor), L89 (Meissner touch corpuscles)

literalGroups.literal: В коже находятся тактильные рецепторы, включая клетки Меркеля и тельца Мейснера.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The note adds named examples beyond the prompt and key: Merkel cells and Meissner corpuscles are tactile receptors in skin.
literalGroups.locator: OpenStax skin L59 (Merkel receptor), L89 (Meissner corpuscles are touch receptors)

literalGroups.literal: Печень обрабатывает питательные вещества и токсины из крови, а также производит желчь.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The liver source states that it produces bile, processes nutrients and toxins delivered in blood, and hepatocytes process bloodborne nutrients/toxins.
literalGroups.locator: OpenStax liver L31 (bile), L39 (nutrients and toxins in blood processed), L47-48 (hepatocyte processing)

literalGroups.literal: Тонкая кишка — основной участок переваривания и почти всего всасывания питательных веществ.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The small intestine is the primary digestive organ; most digestion and practically all absorption occur there.
literalGroups.locator: OpenStax intestine L32-36, especially L34; L49 and L97-100 provide supporting digestion/absorption detail

literalGroups.literal: Лёгкое — один из парных органов дыхания; в лёгких происходит газообмен кислорода и углекислого газа.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The lung source describes paired lungs exchanging oxygen and carbon dioxide with atmospheric air, and the pulmonary circulation carrying blood to/from alveolar gas exchange.
